summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) auto-runs on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is an obfuscator.io-obfuscated launcher (`_0xXXXX` identifiers, string-array rotation) that downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` (pinned v1.3.13), extracts the binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses `execFileSync` to invoke the freshly downloaded Bun runtime against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS blob using a rotated string array (`WV8StW` shift rotator), a large mixed numeric/string constant table, and a custom base-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — the standard shape of a packed loader payload. `math_init.js` is not referenced by the library entrypoint `index.js` and is not documented in the README. The package's advertised purpose is a OneReach bot/flow packer CLI, which requires no alternate runtime. The alien-runtime dispatch evades Node-based static analysis, and the obfuscated payload's opaque contents run on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
